HomePage.faq1Question: How can I join as a volunteer?
HomePage.faq1Answer: You can register through our website by filling out the membership form, and you will receive a message containing the following steps such as tests and initial orientation.
HomePage.faq2Question: Is volunteering in the gozbebekleri team paid?
HomePage.faq2Answer: No, volunteering is completely free, but in some programs, transportation allowances or appreciation rewards are provided for active volunteers.
HomePage.faq3Question: How are volunteers selected for projects?
HomePage.faq3Answer: Selection depends on several factors such as specialization, geographic location, and availability, where we try to direct each volunteer to the most suitable opportunity for them.
HomePage.faq4Answer: Yes! We have digital volunteering opportunities including content management, graphic design, digital marketing, and communication with supporting parties.
HomePage.faq5Question: How can I suggest my own initiative?
HomePage.faq5Answer: If you have a humanitarian project idea, the gozbebekleri team can help you implement it by providing resources and logistical support.

AboutUs.associationName: Qurrat Al-Ayun Relief and Solidarity Association
AboutUs.aboutUsDesc1: We are a Turkish relief and solidarity association working in the field of child care and support around the world. We strive to provide children with a better life and a safer future, ease their suffering, support their access to basic rights, and contribute to the development of their mental and physical abilities.
AboutUs.aboutUsDesc2: We also work to integrate children in need into society, raise their awareness of their rights, and improve the social, economic, and psychological conditions of their families through meaningful, high-quality programs and projects.
AboutUs.visionQuote: To make a real difference in the world of childhood and contribute to raising a productive generation that uplifts itself and its community.
AboutUs.goalsTitle: The Goals We Strive to Achieve
AboutUs.goalsDesc: We work to achieve a set of humanitarian, social, and educational goals that serve children, their families, and society.
AboutUs.presidentTitle: A Message from the Association President
AboutUs.ctaDesc: Join us on our journey to build a better future for children around the world
goalsList: To provide quality services for children and their families in the areas of living support, healthcare, psychological support, and education.
To raise generations capable of developing themselves, facing challenges, and building strong personalities.
To discover children's skills, support their creativity, and develop their abilities and talents.
To protect children from all forms of exploitation and neglect, and to strengthen their awareness of their rights.
To contribute to raising generations built on strong values and solid moral principles.
To support sustainable systems in education, training, care, and healthcare services.
To help children reach a brighter, safer, and more hopeful future.
presidentMessageParagraphs: In today's world, especially across the Islamic world, children are among the groups most affected by political crises, economic hardship, wars, and natural disasters.

In the face of this painful reality, we refused to remain mere spectators. Instead, we took action to help build a safer, more hopeful, and more dignified future for every child we can reach, especially orphaned children.

Since 2011, Gözbebekleri Association has been carrying out various projects to support children in need and orphans, particularly in the fields of healthcare, education, nutrition, and social support, while also caring for their families and surrounding environments.

When it comes to children, our guide and example is Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, who was sent as a mercy to all worlds. We seek to follow his compassion and sensitivity toward children by easing their pain, meeting their needs, and becoming a reason for smiles on their faces wherever they may be.

Through our specialized teams and volunteers in different regions of the world, we work to make children feel that they are not alone. We strive to touch their lives, improve their conditions, and open new doors of hope before them.

Our association continues its work without any profit motive, guided by the principle: "Serving people is serving Allah." With sincerity, responsibility, and through your support and trust, we continue delivering goodness to those who need it most.
